title: FreezerPlayer
description: A simple plugin to freeze players, very powerful.
body:
**A simple plugin to freeze players, very powerful.**

No access to commands, inventories, teleportation, warns when disconnected and frozen.

_A visual cue lets you know if the player is frozen, they have a block of ice on their head._

Our discord: https://discord.gg/4DJV7h79fb
